COMMON ORDER

G.R. Swaminathan, J.:— Heard both sides.

2. The petitioners suffered eviction orders under Section 6 of the Land Encroachment Order. Questioning the same, the petitioners had filed appeals before the first respondent. The first respondent is directed to dispose of the said appeals within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. Till the appeal is disposed of, the eviction order shall not be given effect to.

3. The writ petitions are disposed of accordingly. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
